groups.name: zero-trust
groups.description: Root configuration for the Zero Trust Spring Boot starter. Controls deny-by-default security, JWT authentication, RBAC, tenant ABAC, external policy evaluation, rate limiting, and observability.

groups.name: zero-trust.inbound
groups.description: Inbound request security: JWT validation, CORS, path-based authorization, tenant and policy enforcement.

groups.name: zero-trust.inbound.jwt
groups.description: JWT validation settings. Either shared-secret (HS256) or issuer-uri (JWKS) must be set.

groups.name: zero-trust.inbound.cors
groups.description: CORS configuration. Wildcard '*' origins are rejected at startup when mode=STRICT.

groups.name: zero-trust.inbound.tenant
groups.description: Tenant-aware ABAC. Verifies that the inbound tenant header matches the tenant claim in the JWT.

groups.name: zero-trust.inbound.policy
groups.description: External policy engine integration (OPA-like). Protected paths are evaluated via POST to the configured endpoint.

groups.name: zero-trust.outbound
groups.description: Outbound call security: automatic JWT propagation and service-token fallback for RestClient, WebClient, and RestTemplate.

groups.name: zero-trust.rate-limit
groups.description: Request rate limiting per authenticated principal or client IP. Uses a token-bucket algorithm.

groups.name: zero-trust.guardrails
groups.description: Startup-time fail-fast checks. When disabled, unsafe configurations (wildcard public paths, missing JWT config, permissive CORS) are allowed.

properties.name: zero-trust.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for the Zero Trust starter. When false, none of the starter beans are created.

properties.name: zero-trust.mode
properties.description: Operating mode. STRICT enforces production-grade guardrails (no wildcard CORS, no wildcard public paths). BALANCED and DEV are reserved for future relaxations.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.enabled
properties.description: Enable inbound security filter chain (JWT, RBAC, deny-by-default).

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.jwt.issuer
properties.description: Expected 'iss' claim value in JWTs. Used to validate that tokens come from your identity provider.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.jwt.issuer-uri
properties.description: Issuer URI that exposes JWKS (e.g. Keycloak realm URL). When set, public keys are fetched automatically.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.jwt.shared-secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 shared secret for JWT validation. Alternative to issuer-uri. Use only for demos or internal systems.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.jwt.audiences
properties.description: Expected 'aud' claim values. JWTs without a matching audience are rejected.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.jwt.roles-claim
properties.description: JWT claim name that holds the list of roles. Values are converted to Spring Security authorities with the ROLE_ prefix.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.jwt.principal-claim
properties.description: JWT claim name used as the principal name.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: List of CORS origins allowed for cross-origin requests. Wildcard '*' is rejected at startup in STRICT mode.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.public-paths
properties.description: Ant-style paths accessible without authentication. Wildcard '/**' is rejected at startup.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.admin-paths
properties.description: Ant-style paths that require ROLE_ADMIN.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.service-paths
properties.description: Ant-style paths that require ROLE_SERVICE (for service-to-service calls).

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.tenant.enabled
properties.description: Enable tenant ABAC enforcement.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.tenant.header-name
properties.description: HTTP header that carries the tenant identifier from the client.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.tenant.claim-name
properties.description: JWT claim that holds the authoritative tenant identifier. Must match the header for the request to pass.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.tenant.protected-paths
properties.description: Ant-style paths where tenant ABAC is enforced.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.policy.enabled
properties.description: Enable integration with an external OPA-like policy engine.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.policy.engine
properties.description: Policy engine label (informational).

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.policy.endpoint
properties.description: HTTP endpoint of the policy engine that receives POST {input: ...} and returns {allow, reason}.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.policy.fail-closed
properties.description: When true, requests are denied with 503 if the policy engine is unreachable. When false, requests are allowed on engine failure.

properties.name: zero-trust.inbound.policy.protected-paths
properties.description: Ant-style paths evaluated by the external policy engine.

properties.name: zero-trust.outbound.enabled
properties.description: Enable automatic bearer-token propagation on outbound HTTP calls (RestClient, WebClient, RestTemplate).

properties.name: zero-trust.outbound.token-mode
properties.description: Strategy for choosing the outbound bearer token. USER_ONLY propagates only the user JWT. USER_OR_SERVICE falls back to a service token when no user is present. SERVICE_ONLY always uses the service token.

properties.name: zero-trust.outbound.service-token
properties.description: Direct JWT value used as the service token. Convenient for tests; not recommended for production.

properties.name: zero-trust.outbound.service-token-environment-variable
properties.description: Name of the environment variable (or system property) from which to read the service token.

properties.name: zero-trust.outbound.service-token-secret-path
properties.description: Vault-style path where the service token is stored (e.g. secret/services/gateway).

properties.name: zero-trust.outbound.service-token-secret-key
properties.description: Key inside the Vault-style secret entry that holds the service token.

properties.name: zero-trust.rate-limit.enabled
properties.description: Enable per-principal rate limiting. Requests exceeding the limit receive HTTP 429.

properties.name: zero-trust.rate-limit.requests-per-second
properties.description: Sustained rate (tokens refilled per second).

properties.name: zero-trust.rate-limit.burst-capacity
properties.description: Maximum burst size. Must be >= requests-per-second.

properties.name: zero-trust.guardrails.fail-on-missing-jwt-config
properties.description: Fail startup if neither shared-secret nor issuer-uri is configured.

properties.name: zero-trust.guardrails.fail-on-wildcard-public-paths
properties.description: Fail startup if '/**' is listed as a public path.

properties.name: zero-trust.guardrails.fail-on-permissive-cors
properties.description: Fail startup if '*' is listed as a CORS origin in STRICT mode.

values.description: Production-grade guardrails. Rejects wildcard CORS and wildcard public paths.
